senses.gloss: m. (סָפַק II; v. סָפֵק) strait, dilemma; difficulty.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 3:5:2">Y. Sot. III, 19ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הכניסה עצמה למ׳ הזה המרובה</he> she placed herself in such a dilemma (to be suspected of adultery and to have to drink the waters of jealousy).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 8:8:2">Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מה ראית להכניס עצמך למי׳ הזה וכ׳</he> what was thy reason for taking such a responsibility (by deciding in favor of a lenient opinion)?—
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 5:3">Esth. R. to II, 3</cite> <he>באו לידי המ׳ הזה</he> they (the Persian matrons) came to that trouble (to have to compete with all maidens of the country); a. e.
